_comment: The complete set of finite inputs to the constructions.  Everything else
in this repository is exact integer arithmetic derived from these.
Each entry records the count, the set it counts, and the neutral set it is
measured against.  All five have the shape |J \ N(X0)|.
'sensitivity' is d(final bound)/d(value): how far the Theorem 2 bound moves
if the count is off by one.  C1 carries by far the most leverage.
Every value here is derived from data/base_c7.json by verify_certificates.py
(or live via `verify_arithmetic.py --recomputed`) and matches the manuscript.
The 'sensitivity' fields are approximate floating-point METADATA -- movement
of the final bound per unit change in the count -- not verification outputs;
all verification arithmetic in this repository is exact.

C1.counted_set: J^+ = (T x T)(I_10) after the eight exchanges of Appendix B.1
C1.reference_set: X_10^0, the neutral part of X_10 = X_5 x X_5
C1.note: Highest-leverage certificate and the only one obtained by modifying an automorphic image through exchanges (C3 counts X_15, which is also not a pure automorphic image). |(T x T)(I_10) \ N(X_10^0)| = 27480 before the exchanges.
C1.status: confirmed: derived from data/base_c7.json by verify_certificates.py

C2.reference_set: X_15^{0,X}, neutral part of the common auxiliary set of the three ordinary 15-dim gadgets
C2.status: confirmed: derived from data/base_c7.json by verify_certificates.py

C3.status: confirmed: derived from data/base_c7.json by verify_certificates.py

C4.counted_set: J_30^{++} = T^{x6}(I_30^{++}), I_30^{++} the main code of Gao(G_15^het, G_15^het)

_comment: Trivial-q lemma: if X is independent and X^0 is a subset of X, then
X cap N(X^0) = X^0 exactly, so |X \ N(X^0)| = s - o with no computation.
These are the codebook choices that need no ledger entry.

automorphism_T.note: Coordinate permutation (1,3,0,2,4) composed with the reflection w -> 2-w on two coordinates; an automorphism of C_7^{box 5}.
